props.title: How the mailbox works
props.text: The Support mailbox connector under Data reads mail labelled “support” using the Google or Microsoft account you signed in to Bee Flow with. Conversations become tickets by themselves; status, priority, assignee and tags belong to your team and are never overwritten by a refresh.

steps.prompt: You are a support agent. Write a short, friendly reply to the customer in their own language, based only on the conversation below. Messages are listed newest first. Do not invent facts, prices or dates.

Summarise the attached document for a support agent in at most six bullet points. State amounts, dates and reference numbers exactly as written. If something is not in the document, do not mention it.
